items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: I think Gene was about 18 years old or 19 when he joined the band

ctx.x: It was just a joy to be around somebody like that in a band. Sarah and I later on became fast friends. We'd hang out in cities, we'd drink together. I think hanging around her is when I really got hooked on drinking gin. Sarah and I would hang out in all the places... She's just a beautiful person.

Back to where we were. I think the last city I mentioned was Cleveland. I think we went from Cleveland to Cincinnati. This is where Gene Ammons was... I think Gene was about 18 years old or 19 when he joined the band, and became the tenor saxophone player that lasted through the whole existence of the band, and became one of the major sparks in the band. Anyone that listens to it will understand what I'm saying.
Because the other tenor saxophone player at that particular time was Lucky Thompson. Lucky Thompson at that
